subject: fix compile warning in util.c (#3585)
reason: The change is a build-level fix for a compile warning: it replaces the raw __attribute__((no_sanitize_address, no_sanitize("thread"))) annotations on the string2ll ifunc resolver in src/util.c with the equivalent VALKEY_NO_SANITIZE macros. The resolver body and the string2ll implementations it selects are unchanged, so there is no behaviour change for any runtime path (replies, replication, persistence, cluster); the only effect is on compilation and sanitizer instrumentation. No scenario can distinguish the two builds.
